text:
maya.cs: FYI customer AcmeCorp reports their $500 trial bonus landed in a workspace tied to a service account instead of their main org. Workspace name: acme-staging-service, workspace_id: ws_9a8b7c. Their prod org id is org_9876 but balance shows on org_9876-svc. Anyone seen this after SSO re-provisioning?

olivia.ops: Can you paste how they redeemed the promo? UI or API? Any logs or promo code?

maya.cs: Redeemed via UI. Promo code `ACME-TRIAL-2026`. They went through SSO and there was an old staging service account that matched the acme domain; SSO ended up creating/reattaching a clone workspace. I asked for screenshots and the SSO assertion.

samir.billing: @maya.cs please confirm the workspace_id and promo metadata. We'll need txn_id and billing token for manual transfer. Manual moves require a short audit trail. pinging @olivia.ops to triage root cause.

maya.cs: Here is the promo log we received from the redemption service:```
promo.redeem: {
  code: "ACME-TRIAL-2026",
  redeemed_by: "service-account@acme.com",
  workspace_id: "ws_9a8b7c",
  credited_to_org: "org_9876-svc",
  amount_usd: 500
}
```

ci-bot: deploy+promo-service: new release v1.12.3 promoted at 2026-02-12T09:12:33Z - flagging potential race with onboarding flow :warning:

olivia.ops: This matches an edge case we've seen: when SSO creates a workspace for a non-human identifier (service-account@...) our binding logic can auto-link that workspace to an org variant (org_9876-svc). Reproducible locally. Short-term fix: require explicit org selection for promo redemption or block service-account emails. I'll open an ENG ticket. For immediate unblock, can billing reassign?

samir.billing: We can manual-transfer. Please provide: (1) source workspace_id to revoke (ws_9a8b7c), (2) destination org id (org_9876), (3) proof of ownership (SSO assertion or owner email). Transfers are logged and will get a tx id.

maya.cs: Customer supplied the SSO assertion and confirmed owner email carla@acme.com. They said the trial will expire in 48h so this is urgent. Proof attached in the ticket.

samir.billing: Ack. Creating transfer request and marking high priority. Revoking now from ws_9a8b7c and applying to org_9876. TXN ID: tx_20260212_7701. I will post an update when complete.

samir.billing: Update: transfer completed. Credits removed from ws_9a8b7c and applied to org_9876. tx: tx_20260212_7701. Please confirm with customer.

maya.cs: Confirmed with customer — they see the balance on their main org now :tada: Will leave open for 24h to watch for regressions. Thanks @samir.billing @olivia.ops. Please drop the ENG ticket/PR link here when available.

olivia.ops: ENG ticket INF-4721 created: "prevent promo redemption to service accounts". PR incoming to add an explicit org selector to the promo redemption flow and to blacklist service-account patterns. Adding a note to onboarding docs.

maya.cs: Awesome — closing after 24h if no regressions.
